Dialogue: 0,0:02:36.59,0:02:37.84,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}So it's you, Naruto...?
Dialogue: 0,0:02:43.35,0:02:45.94,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}You don't even have parents or siblings...{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:02:46.55,0:02:48.73,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}What do you know about me?!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:02:49.31,0:02:51.75,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}You've been alone from the start!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:02:51.98,0:02:54.65,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}What do you know about me?! Huh?!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:02:57.53,0:02:59.95,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}It's having the bond that makes it painful!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:00.70,0:03:05.99,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}You've no idea what it's like to lose that...!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:06.83,0:03:07.91,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}You're right.{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:08.20,0:03:12.38,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}I don't know about having real parents or siblings...{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:14.34,0:03:15.55,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}If that's the case...{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:16.50,0:03:18.05,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}Why Naruto...?{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:19.55,0:03:21.93,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}Why do you go so far for me...?{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:23.85,0:03:27.18,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}To me, it's a bond... I've finally been able to establish.{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:28.35,0:03:32.15,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}That's why I'll stop you!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:33.56,0:03:36.94,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}If that's the case, then why didn't you...?
Dialogue: 0,0:03:39.57,0:03:42.82,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}Then I'll just break that bond!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:43.95,0:03:45.95,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Why didn't you kill me back then?!
Dialogue: 0,0:03:46.45,0:03:48.70,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Is that how you wanted to break the bond?!
Dialogue: 0,0:03:49.70,0:03:50.83,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Sasuke!
Dialogue: 0,0:03:53.12,0:03:54.54,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}The reason's simple...
Dialogue: 0,0:03:56.71,0:04:00.13,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}It's not that I couldn't break the bond with you...
Dialogue: 0,0:04:00.97,0:04:03.55,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}You're one who might be able{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:04:03.55,0:04:05.97,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}to use the same Mangekyo Sharingan as mine...{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:04:08.47,0:04:11.35,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}However, there is one condition...{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:04:15.27,0:04:17.27,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}You must kill...{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:04:18.77,0:04:19.94,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}your closest friend.{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:04:20.82,0:04:22.49,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}It was just irritating to me.
Dialogue: 0,0:04:22.53,0:04:26.45,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,480)}Obtaining power according to the method I heard about from him.
Dialogue: 0,0:04:28.24,0:04:33.16,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}You're only alive because of my passing whim.
Dialogue: 0,0:04:49.97,0:04:51.18,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}When did he...?!
Dialogue: 0,0:04:51.89,0:04:53.39,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Come to think of it,
Dialogue: 0,0:04:53.43,0:04:56.77,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}didn't you have a dream of becoming the Hokage...?
Dialogue: 0,0:04:58.36,0:05:00.44,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}If you had the time to chase after me,
Dialogue: 0,0:05:00.48,0:05:02.99,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}you should've spent that time training or something...
Dialogue: 0,0:05:03.95,0:05:05.57,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Right... Naruto?
Dialogue: 0,0:05:07.74,0:05:09.53,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}And that's why this time around...
Dialogue: 0,0:05:09.62,0:05:11.45,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}You'll lose your life...
Dialogue: 0,0:05:14.33,0:05:16.96,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}because of my passing whim.
Dialogue: 0,0:05:25.09,0:05:27.68,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}There's no way a guy who can't even save one friend...
Dialogue: 0,0:05:27.72,0:05:29.43,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}can ever become the Hokage.
Dialogue: 0,0:05:32.01,0:05:34.10,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Isn't that right... Sasuke?
Dialogue: 0,0:05:41.94,0:05:43.03,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Sasuke-kun!
Dialogue: 0,0:05:58.79,0:06:00.50,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Naruto...
Dialogue: 0,0:06:04.34,0:06:11.30,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Show him... our... powers.
Dialogue: 0,0:06:16.64,0:06:18.06,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}What's the matter...?
Dialogue: 0,0:06:29.41,0:06:31.74,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Why do you hesitate...?
Dialogue: 0,0:06:34.91,0:06:38.50,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}You need my power, don't you?
Dialogue: 0,0:06:44.84,0:06:46.63,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Now then...
Dialogue: 0,0:06:50.38,0:06:52.93,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Who do you want to kill...?
Dialogue: 0,0:06:55.85,0:06:58.48,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}You should know.
Dialogue: 0,0:06:59.14,0:07:02.56,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}That you can't do anything on your own.
Dialogue: 0,0:07:03.15,0:07:12.24,Signs,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\fnIwata Gyousho Pro-Kami B\fs60\bord0\blur0.6\c&H25383C&\move(350,184,350,445,)\clip(0,59,708,418)\frx12\fry344\frz3.666\1a&H35&}seal
Dialogue: 0,0:07:04.36,0:07:06.90,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Break the seal completely!
Dialogue: 0,0:07:07.23,0:07:11.95,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}I'll grant you all of my powers if you do.
Dialogue: 0,0:07:21.46,0:07:22.28,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}How...?!
Dialogue: 0,0:07:24.29,0:07:25.88,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}I can see it now...
Dialogue: 0,0:07:26.84,0:07:29.38,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}So this is your unknown power, huh...?
Dialogue: 0,0:07:30.68,0:07:32.13,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Who would've thought...
Dialogue: 0,0:07:32.18,0:07:35.39,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}you'd have something like this inside of you...

Dialogue: 0,0:00:31.05,0:00:32.09,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}He's not in here.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:39.01,0:00:40.60,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}He's not in here, either!
Dialogue: 0,0:00:47.65,0:00:48.77,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}He's not in here, either!
Dialogue: 0,0:00:55.78,0:00:58.24,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Where the hell... are you?!
Dialogue: 0,0:00:59.41,0:01:02.25,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}We've finally... made it this far!
Dialogue: 0,0:01:03.91,0:01:05.04,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Where are you...?!
Dialogue: 0,0:01:06.25,0:01:07.50,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Where are you?
Dialogue: 0,0:01:09.09,0:01:10.84,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Sasuke!
Dialogue: 0,0:01:40.53,0:01:41.58,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Sakura, huh?
Dialogue: 0,0:01:53.92,0:01:56.63,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Sa...su...ke.
Dialogue: 0,0:02:33.38,0:02:34.55,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Sasuke...
Dialogue: 0,0:02:36.59,0:02:37.84,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}So it's you, Naruto...?
Dialogue: 0,0:02:43.35,0:02:45.94,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}You don't even have parents or siblings...{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:02:46.55,0:02:48.73,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}What do you know about me?!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:02:49.31,0:02:51.75,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}You've been alone from the start!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:02:51.98,0:02:54.65,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}What do you know about me?! Huh?!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:02:57.53,0:02:59.95,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}It's having the bond that makes it painful!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:00.70,0:03:05.99,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}You've no idea what it's like to lose that...!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:06.83,0:03:07.91,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}You're right.{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:08.20,0:03:12.38,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}I don't know about having real parents or siblings...{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:14.34,0:03:15.55,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}If that's the case...{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:16.50,0:03:18.05,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}Why Naruto...?{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:19.55,0:03:21.93,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}Why do you go so far for me...?{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:23.85,0:03:27.18,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}To me, it's a bond... I've finally been able to establish.{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:28.35,0:03:32.15,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}That's why I'll stop you!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:33.56,0:03:36.94,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}If that's the case, then why didn't you...?
Dialogue: 0,0:03:39.57,0:03:42.82,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}Then I'll just break that bond!{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:03:43.95,0:03:45.95,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Why didn't you kill me back then?!
Dialogue: 0,0:03:46.45,0:03:48.70,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Is that how you wanted to break the bond?!
Dialogue: 0,0:03:49.70,0:03:50.83,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Sasuke!
Dialogue: 0,0:03:53.12,0:03:54.54,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}The reason's simple...
Dialogue: 0,0:03:56.71,0:04:00.13,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}It's not that I couldn't break the bond with you...
Dialogue: 0,0:04:00.97,0:04:03.55,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}You're one who might be able{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:04:03.55,0:04:05.97,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}to use the same Mangekyo Sharingan as mine...{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:04:08.47,0:04:11.35,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}However, there is one condition...{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:04:15.27,0:04:17.27,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}You must kill...{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:04:18.77,0:04:19.94,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)\i1}your closest friend.{\i0}
Dialogue: 0,0:04:20.82,0:04:22.49,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}It was just irritating to me.
Dialogue: 0,0:04:22.53,0:04:26.45,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,480)}Obtaining power according to the method I heard about from him.
Dialogue: 0,0:04:28.24,0:04:33.16,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}You're only alive because of my passing whim.
Dialogue: 0,0:04:49.97,0:04:51.18,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}When did he...?!
Dialogue: 0,0:04:51.89,0:04:53.39,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Come to think of it,
Dialogue: 0,0:04:53.43,0:04:56.77,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}didn't you have a dream of becoming the Hokage...?
Dialogue: 0,0:04:58.36,0:05:00.44,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}If you had the time to chase after me,
Dialogue: 0,0:05:00.48,0:05:02.99,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}you should've spent that time training or something...
Dialogue: 0,0:05:03.95,0:05:05.57,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Right... Naruto?
Dialogue: 0,0:05:07.74,0:05:09.53,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}And that's why this time around...
Dialogue: 0,0:05:09.62,0:05:11.45,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}You'll lose your life...
Dialogue: 0,0:05:14.33,0:05:16.96,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}because of my passing whim.
Dialogue: 0,0:05:25.09,0:05:27.68,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}There's no way a guy who can't even save one friend...
Dialogue: 0,0:05:27.72,0:05:29.43,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}can ever become the Hokage.
Dialogue: 0,0:05:32.01,0:05:34.10,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Isn't that right... Sasuke?
Dialogue: 0,0:05:41.94,0:05:43.03,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Sasuke-kun!
Dialogue: 0,0:05:58.79,0:06:00.50,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Naruto...
Dialogue: 0,0:06:04.34,0:06:11.30,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Show him... our... powers.
Dialogue: 0,0:06:16.64,0:06:18.06,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}What's the matter...?
Dialogue: 0,0:06:29.41,0:06:31.74,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Why do you hesitate...?
Dialogue: 0,0:06:34.91,0:06:38.50,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}You need my power, don't you?
Dialogue: 0,0:06:44.84,0:06:46.63,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Now then...
Dialogue: 0,0:06:50.38,0:06:52.93,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Who do you want to kill...?
Dialogue: 0,0:06:55.85,0:06:58.48,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}You should know.
Dialogue: 0,0:06:59.14,0:07:02.56,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}That you can't do anything on your own.
Dialogue: 0,0:07:03.15,0:07:12.24,Signs,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\fnIwata Gyousho Pro-Kami B\fs60\bord0\blur0.6\c&H25383C&\move(350,184,350,445,)\clip(0,59,708,418)\frx12\fry344\frz3.666\1a&H35&}seal
Dialogue: 0,0:07:04.36,0:07:06.90,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Break the seal completely!
Dialogue: 0,0:07:07.23,0:07:11.95,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}I'll grant you all of my powers if you do.
Dialogue: 0,0:07:21.46,0:07:22.28,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}How...?!
Dialogue: 0,0:07:24.29,0:07:25.88,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}I can see it now...
Dialogue: 0,0:07:26.84,0:07:29.38,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}So this is your unknown power, huh...?
Dialogue: 0,0:07:30.68,0:07:32.13,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}Who would've thought...
Dialogue: 0,0:07:32.18,0:07:35.39,Default,NTP,0,0,0,!Effect,{\pos(352,465)}you'd have something like this inside of you...

Hardship, regret, shame: the negative feelings that humans feel become Curses that lurk in our everyday lives. The Curses run rampant throughout the world, capable of leading people to terrible misfortune and even death. What's more, the Curses can only be exorcised by another Curse.

Itadori Yuji is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life.
